description: This file provides utility functions and classes for accessibility object manipulation, including descendant/ancestor searches, attribute conversions, and bounding box handling, within the pyatspi accessibility framework.

classes.name: BoundingBox
classes.description: A list subclass representing a bounding box with properties for x, y, width, and height.

methods.name: setCacheLevel
methods.description: Stub function to set cache level; not implemented.

methods.name: getCacheLevel
methods.description: Stub function to get cache level; not implemented.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Stub function to clear cache; not implemented.

methods.name: printCache
methods.description: Prints a deprecation message for cache printing.

methods.name: getInterfaceIID
methods.description: Returns a deprecated, empty string for interface ID.

methods.name: getInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns the interface name by stripping a prefix from the object's _dbus_interface attribute.

methods.name: listInterfaces
methods.description: Returns a set of supported interface names via the object's get_interfaces() method.

methods.name: stringToConst
methods.description: Maps a string to an AT-SPI constant based on prefix and suffix.

methods.name: stateToString
methods.description: Converts a state value to its string name using a lookup table.

methods.name: relationToString
methods.description: Converts a relation value to its string name using a lookup table.

methods.name: findDescendant
methods.description: Searches for a descendant accessible node matching a predicate, depth- or breadth-first.

methods.name: _findDescendantBreadth
methods.description: Internal helper for breadth-first descendant search.

methods.name: _findDescendantDepth
methods.description: Internal helper for depth-first descendant search.

methods.name: findAllDescendants
methods.description: Finds all descendant nodes matching a predicate.

methods.name: _findAllDescendants
methods.description: Recursive helper to collect all matching descendants.

methods.name: findAncestor
methods.description: Searches upward for an ancestor matching a predicate.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Builds a path of child indices from the root to the accessible object.

methods.name: pointToList
methods.description: Converts a point object with x and y to a tuple.

methods.name: rectToList
methods.description: Converts a rect object with x, y, width, height to a tuple.

methods.name: attributeListToHash
methods.description: Converts a list of 'key:val' strings into a dictionary.

methods.name: hashToAttributeList
methods.description: Converts a dictionary into a list of 'key:val' strings.

methods.name: getBoundingBox
methods.description: Creates a BoundingBox instance from a rect object.
